personas.title: Community Member
personas.role: Lives near a proposed or existing nuclear facility
personas.job: Understand what is proposed nearby, possible local effects, and opportunities to participate.

questions.text: What is proposed near me, exactly where, and who is responsible?
Is this an announcement, a license application, an approved project, or construction?
What does the environmental review say about water, land use, and construction effects?
What spent fuel or waste would remain at the site, and what plan is documented?
When can I attend a public meeting, submit comments, or contact the responsible authority?

personas.title: Government Official
personas.role: A local, regional, or national official involved in nuclear decisions
personas.job: Understand the projects and public responsibilities within a jurisdiction.

questions.text: Which projects and facilities fall within our jurisdiction?
Which decisions belong to local, regional, or national authorities?
What milestones or public consultations require our participation?
What local infrastructure, employment, and environmental effects are documented?
What responsibilities remain after operations end?

personas.title: Regulatory Reviewer
personas.role: Reviews nuclear applications, compliance, or oversight records
personas.job: Find public regulatory records and understand the context of a facility or application.

questions.text: Which applications and license actions are publicly recorded for a facility?
Who is the applicant or license holder?
What is the documented stage of the regulatory review?
Which source documents support the reported status and dates?
Which related facilities or activities need to be distinguished from this application?

personas.title: Project Developer
personas.role: Advances a proposed nuclear facility through development
personas.job: Compare the public evidence behind projects, dependencies, and development milestones.

questions.text: Which comparable projects use the technology we are evaluating?
Which projects have progressed from announcement to an application or permit?
What site and environmental review milestones are documented?
Which fuel or electricity purchase commitments have been publicly disclosed?
What supports the reported construction and operating dates?

personas.title: Facility Owner or Operator
personas.role: Owns or operates a reactor or fuel-cycle facility
personas.job: Understand the published operational, licensing, and lifecycle record of a facility.

questions.text: Which public records describe this facility and its operating status?
What generation, capacity, and outage information is publicly available?
Which license changes or renewals have been documented?
What fuel-cycle and spent-fuel facilities are associated with the site?
What closure or decommissioning milestones are publicly reported?

personas.title: Fuel Buyer
personas.role: Procures fuel or fuel-cycle services for a developer or operator
personas.job: Identify potential suppliers and the evidence needed before procurement discussions.

questions.text: Which organizations report uranium supply, conversion, enrichment, or fabrication capabilities?
Which suppliers report producing TRISO fuel, and where are their facilities?
Which suppliers handle low-enriched uranium or HALEU, and at which processing step?
What operating status and licensed or announced capacity are documented?
What must we confirm directly about qualification, available supply, price, and delivery?

personas.title: Supplier or Contractor
personas.role: Provides fuel, equipment, engineering, construction, or services
personas.job: Find relevant projects and understand their publicly documented requirements.

questions.text: Which projects could need the capability or service we provide?
Which organizations are developing or operating those projects?
What development and licensing milestones have been reached?
What procurement requirements or supplier announcements are public?
Which target dates are supported by evidence rather than an announcement alone?

personas.title: Electricity Buyer
personas.role: Evaluates nuclear electricity for a utility or business
personas.job: Screen projects and understand the evidence behind public electricity commitments.

questions.text: Which nuclear projects have announced electricity purchase agreements?
Who are the named buyers, developers, and operators?
Does reported capacity refer to the whole plant or a particular agreement?
What delivery date is reported, and which milestones support it?
Which commercial terms and remaining supply require direct confirmation?

personas.title: Nuclear Worker
personas.role: Works in nuclear construction, operations, or site closure
personas.job: Understand a facility’s stage and the public evidence behind workforce changes.

questions.text: Which nearby facilities are being built, operated, or decommissioned?
Who is responsible for the site and its major contracts?
What project milestones could affect the timing of work?
What workforce or training requirements have been publicly documented?
What closure or transition plans have been announced for the site?

personas.title: Union Representative
personas.role: Represents workers affected by nuclear development or closure
personas.job: Track projects and documented workforce commitments affecting members.

questions.text: Which projects could create, extend, or end work for our members?
Which employers and contractors are publicly identified?
What workforce commitments appear in public project documents?
What construction or closure schedule underlies those commitments?
Where are opportunities to participate in decisions affecting workers?

personas.title: Researcher or Technical Expert
personas.role: Studies nuclear systems, policy, or impacts
personas.job: Find traceable records and understand the limits of comparisons.

questions.text: Which original sources support this record’s claims?
What dates, units, and geographic boundaries apply to the data?
Which records can be compared on a consistent basis?
Where are missing values, conflicting claims, or approximate locations?
Can I reproduce the published snapshot and cite its sources?

personas.title: University Educator or Student
personas.role: Teaches or learns about the nuclear lifecycle
personas.job: Connect nuclear concepts to real facilities and original evidence.

questions.text: Which real facilities illustrate each stage of the nuclear lifecycle?
How do fuel production, electricity generation, and spent-fuel storage differ?
What does a license or public filing establish about a project?
How can I distinguish an exact site location from an approximate marker?
Which original documents can I use for further study?

personas.title: Journalist
personas.role: Reports on nuclear projects, policy, or local impacts
personas.job: Verify announcements and connect reporting to original public records.

questions.text: What has actually happened, and what is still only proposed?
Which original document supports the headline claim?
Who owns, develops, operates, or regulates the facility?
What is unknown, disputed, or out of date?
What upcoming public decisions or meetings warrant follow-up?

personas.title: Civil-Society Representative
personas.role: Represents an environmental or other public-interest organization
personas.job: Examine public claims and participate in decisions affecting represented interests.

questions.text: Which proposals or facilities affect the interests we represent?
What environmental and waste-management claims are documented?
What evidence supports claimed benefits and potential burdens?
Which organizations hold responsibility for the relevant decisions?
When and how can our organization participate or submit evidence?

personas.title: Neighbouring-Country Representative
personas.role: Works on nuclear developments with cross-border relevance
personas.job: Identify cross-border context and the public records needed for cooperation.

questions.text: Which facilities or proposals have potential cross-border relevance?
Which national authorities are responsible?
What environmental assessments address effects beyond the host jurisdiction?
What public consultation or cooperation arrangements are documented?
Where do differences in definitions, dates, or reporting limit comparisons?
